comment: Every URL this project does not control yet, in one place.
Why: a README full of plausible-looking URLs for a repository that does not
exist is worse than a README with obvious holes in it. github.com/nopeat
resolves to nothing today, so every badge on the front page is broken and every
'report an issue' link goes nowhere - and nothing in the repository says so,
because broken external links are not build failures.
1. put the real value in `value` below, for one link or for all of them;
3. commit. CI runs `links.mjs` on every build and the release workflow runs
it with --deny, so a release cannot go out with a placeholder still in it.
The tokens are substituted textually, so a URL that is a repository path keeps
its suffix readable: {{REPO_URL}}/issues, {{REPO_URL}}.git. That way the files
still read as URLs and still diff sensibly once filled in.

REPO_URL.note: The GitHub repository. Everything that is a path inside it - issues, discussions, releases, the CI badge URL, blob/main links - is this token plus a suffix.

REPO_SLUG.note: The same repository as owner/name, for the shields.io release badge, which cannot take a full URL. No scheme, no .git.

NPM_PACKAGE.note: The npm package name. Must match npm/nopeat/package.json; links.mjs checks that it does.

NPM_URL.note: The npm package page, for the install instructions and the npm badge target. Until this is set, links.mjs refuses an npm badge or an offered `npx nopeat` on any README: the package does not exist yet, so both are 404s. Setting this is where they come back.

CRATES_CORE_PACKAGE.note: The crates.io name of the core crate. Must match crates/nopeat-core/Cargo.toml; links.mjs checks that it does.

CRATES_CORE_URL.note: The crates.io page for the core crate. Same rule as NPM_URL: no crates.io badge and no offered `cargo install nopeat-cli` until this is set.

DOCS_URL.note: The documentation site home page. GitHub Pages serves a project site from /<repository>/ and that path is case sensitive, so the value is the repository name as spelled, not lowercased. The same checker rule as the rest applies: while any token is empty, a hardcoded nopeat.github.io URL anywhere in the tree is treated as invented.
